svg.text: MULTI-VENDOR AI ACCELERATORS: NVIDIA H200/B200 VS. GOOGLE TPU VS. AMD MI325X VS. AWS TRAINIUM2
Multi-Backend Portfolio (`NVIDIA + TPU + AMD MI325X + Trainium2`) Cuts Token Cost 60.5%
25B Tokens/Mo Fleet: Tier 1 Single-Vendor On-Demand ($425K/mo) vs. Tier 2 MI325X (2TB HBM/node) vs. Tier 4 Portfolio ($168K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 Trap: Single-Vendor Lock-In & Custom C++ Ops
1. Hardcoding Vendor-Specific C++ Kernels Blocks Cloud Arbitrage:
• Writing bespoke non-standard ops prevents shifting standard
`Llama / Qwen / DeepSeek` inference to 40% cheaper ASICs/GPUs!
2. Missing AMD `MI300X (192GB) / MI325X (256GB)` Memory Advantage:
• An `8x MI325X` node provides `2,048 GB` HBM3e (`6.0 TB/s/GPU`),
fitting `671B BF16` unquantized or `1.3 TB` of KV Cache on 1 box!
3. Ignoring Cloud-Native ASICs (`Google TPU` & `AWS Trainium2`):
• `TPU v6e/Ironwood` & `Trn2 UltraServer` cut cloud $/tok by 40%+
Tier 1 Single-Vendor On-Demand Lock-In Impact:
• Cross-Vendor Workload Portability: 0.0%
• Effective Token Cost: $0.68 / 1M Tokens
• Monthly 25B-Token Fleet TCO: $425,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 4-Vendor Accelerator Portfolio Strategy
1. `NVIDIA H200 / B200 / NVL72`: Frontier Pre-Training & `EP=72` MoE
• Best for bleeding-edge kernels (`DeepEP IBGDA`, `NVFP4`, `FlashMLA`)
2. `AMD Instinct MI300X (192GB) / MI325X (256GB)`: Single-Node Giant
• `2 TB` HBM/node (`896 GB/s xGMI`) excels at single-node `70B–671B` Decode
3. `Google TPU v5p/v6e/Ironwood` & `AWS Trainium2 (Trn2 UltraServer)`:
• `3D Torus ICI/NeuronLink` + `vLLM-TPU / vLLM-Neuron` for low-TCO serving
4. Unified Abstraction (`OpenAI Gateway + vLLM/SGLang + Triton`):
• Shifts 80% of standard models across chips with zero app changes!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (25B Tokens/Mo):
• Workload Portability: 96.5% | Max 8-Chip Node HBM: 2,048 GB
• Blended Token Cost: $0.24 / 1M Tokens (-64.7% vs. Tier 1)
• Monthly Fleet TCO: $168,000 / mo (-60.5% savings)
